requirements.title: The PR router MUST classify documentation-only, F# domain-only, browser-only, and cross-cutting changes from normalized changed paths using a committed versioned policy. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The PR router MUST classify documentation-only, F# domain-only, browser-only, and cross-cutting changes from normalized changed paths using a committed versioned policy. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Every routed and skipped gate MUST record the matching policy fact, and unknown paths MUST select the conservative cross-cutting route. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Every routed and skipped gate MUST record the matching policy fact, and unknown paths MUST select the conservative cross-cutting route. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Required PR feedback MUST complete within 300 seconds from runner start to actionable deterministic join verdict on the declared `ubuntu-latest` runner for the representative route matrix. The representative cross-cutting acceptance run MUST complete within 240 seconds, retaining at least 60 seconds of headroom for observed runner variance and bounded producer-inventory growth; retrying an over-budget head does not satisfy this requirement. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: Required PR feedback MUST complete within 300 seconds from runner start to actionable deterministic join verdict on the declared `ubuntu-latest` runner for the representative route matrix. The representative cross-cutting acceptance run MUST complete within 240 seconds, retaining at least 60 seconds of headroom for observed runner variance and bounded producer-inventory growth; retrying an over-budget head does not satisfy this requirement. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Formatting, compilation, signature, generated-view, and deterministic contract failures MUST be ordered before expensive browser/performance work, while independent gates remain explicit DAG nodes with fixed attribution. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: Formatting, compilation, signature, generated-view, and deterministic contract failures MUST be ordered before expensive browser/performance work, while independent gates remain explicit DAG nodes with fixed attribution. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Native, Fable, client, server, and documentation prerequisites MUST be produced at most once per candidate unless a named clean-room subject requires isolation, then published as immutable content-addressed artifacts for consumers. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Native, Fable, client, server, and documentation prerequisites MUST be produced at most once per candidate unless a named clean-room subject requires isolation, then published as immutable content-addressed artifacts for consumers. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: Reuse MUST reject source, configuration, dependency lock, toolchain, owning command, candidate revision/tree, expected path, or output-identity drift and retain exact-once Fable inventory checks. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Reuse MUST reject source, configuration, dependency lock, toolchain, owning command, candidate revision/tree, expected path, or output-identity drift and retain exact-once Fable inventory checks. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: Rules, spatial, cancellation, browser, documentation, and evidence checks MUST expose concurrent DAG nodes and a deterministic mutation-tested join rather than one opaque serial failure. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Rules, spatial, cancellation, browser, documentation, and evidence checks MUST expose concurrent DAG nodes and a deterministic mutation-tested join rather than one opaque serial failure. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Protected ship qualification MUST retain complete clean-cache, mutation, production browser/docs, performance, Governance, SDD verify/ship, cross-runtime, and historical compatibility subjects. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: Protected ship qualification MUST retain complete clean-cache, mutation, production browser/docs, performance, Governance, SDD verify/ship, cross-runtime, and historical compatibility subjects. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: A scheduled full route MUST exercise the same retained full surface and prove a cross-surface defect omitted by a valid focused route is still caught. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: A scheduled full route MUST exercise the same retained full surface and prove a cross-surface defect omitted by a valid focused route is still caught. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: Route, artifact, gate, and aggregate receipts MUST bind exact commit/tree, locks, tools, commands, inputs, outputs, ownership, and result under committed versioned schemas. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)
requirements.text: Route, artifact, gate, and aggregate receipts MUST bind exact commit/tree, locks, tools, commands, inputs, outputs, ownership, and result under committed versioned schemas. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)

requirements.title: Timing evidence MUST separate runner feedback from product performance and record per-gate queue/setup/restore/build/test/total durations, cache/reuse facts, invocation counts, routes/skips, retries, failure stage, critical path, and runner-minutes. (Stories: US-002, US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)

requirements.title: Changed-path, unknown-path, missing/stale/malformed-receipt, cache-poisoning, duplicate-build, unknown-build, deterministic-join, and authority-boundary mutations MUST fail closed and restore every changed fixture. (Stories: US-001, US-004; Acceptance: AC-007)
requirements.text: Changed-path, unknown-path, missing/stale/malformed-receipt, cache-poisoning, duplicate-build, unknown-build, deterministic-join, and authority-boundary mutations MUST fail closed and restore every changed fixture. (Stories: US-001, US-004; Acceptance: AC-007)

decisions.title: Commit a closed, ordered route-policy schema with documentation, domain, browser, and cross-cutting classifications; mixed or unknown inputs select cross-cutting and every gate records its matching rule.
decisions.decision: Commit a closed, ordered route-policy schema with documentation, domain, browser, and cross-cutting classifications; mixed or unknown inputs select cross-cutting and every gate records its matching rule.

decisions.title: Keep a cheap always-on integrity job for route/config/lock/receipt/inventory/generated-view/audit/authority checks, and require it before any expensive route job.
decisions.decision: Keep a cheap always-on integrity job for route/config/lock/receipt/inventory/generated-view/audit/authority checks, and require it before any expensive route job.

decisions.title: Prepare candidate prerequisites once, bind them through the current production receipt plus an immutable route manifest, and verify identities after artifact download; clean-room full qualification is a separate named exception.
decisions.decision: Prepare candidate prerequisites once, bind them through the current production receipt plus an immutable route manifest, and verify identities after artifact download; clean-room full qualification is a separate named exception.

decisions.title: Model each gate as a stable DAG result and use an unconditional deterministic join that rejects missing or unexpected states and accepts skips only when policy says non-applicable.
decisions.decision: Model each gate as a stable DAG result and use an unconditional deterministic join that rejects missing or unexpected states and accepts skips only when policy says non-applicable.

decisions.title: Budget the latest candidate from focused runner start to join verdict at 300,000 ms, require the representative cross-cutting acceptance run to finish within 240,000 ms, record phase/gate/critical-path/runner-minute facts, and never mix this runner contract with gameplay performance.
decisions.decision: Budget the latest candidate from focused runner start to join verdict at 300,000 ms, require the representative cross-cutting acceptance run to finish within 240,000 ms, record phase/gate/critical-path/runner-minute facts, and never mix this runner contract with gameplay performance.

decisions.title: PR events own focused qualification; protected pushes and schedules own the complete clean-room route, with concurrency cancellation limited to superseded PR candidates.
decisions.decision: PR events own focused qualification; protected pushes and schedules own the complete clean-room route, with concurrency cancellation limited to superseded PR candidates.
